description: This PHP class 'UpgraderConfigUtility' provides methods for database connection management and system checks, specifically verifying database existence and connectivity during system upgrade procedures within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UpgraderConfigUtility
classes.description: Utility class for performing upgrade-related database checks and connection verifications.

methods.name: checkDatabaseStatus
methods.description: Checks if the upgrade status table exists in the database, indicating the upgrade process state.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a Doctrine DBAL database connection instance.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Obtains the schema manager for performing database schema operations.

methods.name: checkDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Verifies the database connection and raises exceptions if the database integrity or connection is not proper.
